title: Inventory and Aftermath
author: Dominic Sandoval
blurb: Ansel Oyelaran, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
